analysis.title: DeskTalk - Democrats secure the Senate, risk assets retreat
key_insights: The AP projected Democrats regain the Senate just before midnight ET, flipping Iowa, Kansas, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina and Texas, for 51 seats on current AP projections. The note calls the result a 'blue sweep.'
Incumbent Texas Governor Greg Abbott lost to Gina Hinojosa, the first Democratic Texas governor since 1990. Citi strategists had flagged the race as a key risk to the AI trade.

Markets moved risk-off after the results. SPX futures are 1.3% lower and Nasdaq-100 futures are 2.3% lower, so the weakness is concentrated in tech. In Asia the Kospi is down 3% and the Nikkei down 4.5%.
Citi eFX saw broad inflows into JPY. Leveraged accounts were net buyers of JPY, GBP, CAD and HKD and sellers of USD, EUR, AUD, CHF and CNH. Investor segment flows skewed into USD, JPY and EUR.
President Trump told the NYT he is 'absolutely willing to accept those results.'
Citi points clients to its 'Blue Sweep' basket (CGUSBLUW) as US equity markets open Wednesday.
